summary: shipping-service lost connectivity to shipping-db during a brief network partition between availability zones, causing order fulfillment requests to fail until connectivity was restored.
root_cause: A transient network partition between availability zones interrupted the link between shipping-service and shipping-db for roughly six minutes; the service had no retry/backoff logic and simply failed every request during that window.
fix: Added exponential backoff retry logic for database connections and cross-AZ network monitoring alerts.
